title: Speaking images. A novel framework for the automated self-description of artworks.

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of LLM-generated artwork descriptions to identify Western-centric assumptions and modern cultural constructs (e.g., automatically associating a cake with candles with a birthday party) applied to historical art artifacts.

Testing LLM safety guardrails (e.g., Llama Guard 3 Vision) with historical artwork images and titles to identify false positive censorship, such as flagging benign artistic photography as harmful or censoring the word 'Ecstasy' in a religious painting title.
